title: DHCP snooping: protect VLAN 20
summary: Protect a client VLAN while trusting only the infrastructure-facing path.
brief: Enable DHCP snooping for VLAN 20 and trust Ethernet48 as the legitimate DHCP-server-facing uplink. Leave endpoint ports untrusted. Verify the local configuration. This lab does not simulate DHCP leases, binding-table entries, IP Source Guard, ARP inspection, or spoofed traffic enforcement.
objectives: Verify snooping state and running configuration
hints: Enable DHCP snooping globally before choosing protected VLANs.
Use the DHCP snooping VLAN command for VLAN 20.
Trust only the infrastructure-facing uplink, not endpoint ports.

checks.label: DHCP snooping is enabled for VLAN 20
Ethernet48 is trusted for DHCP server traffic
